name: Samalut

queries.query: Samalut Egypt official cadastral map parcels GIS land registry Egyptian Survey Authority
queries.result: Official discovery identified the Egyptian Survey Authority (ESA) as the national surveying and cadastral-mapping authority. Its public services describe digital maps and property/land mapping, but no Samalut-specific public parcel viewer or parcel API was exposed. An official national ArcGIS service was inspected; its layers are Building, CITY, CENTER, STATE and Equipments, with no parcel layer.

queries.query: سمالوط مصر خريطة كادسترية أراضي جهاز المساحة والسجل العيني بوابة جغرافية رسمية
queries.result: Arabic discovery found the official Egyptian Survey Authority pages describing digital maps, property/land mapping and the national cadastral-record project, plus official Samalut references in government publications. These establish national agency context but did not expose a public Samalut parcel layer, stable parcel identity, or parcel geometry endpoint.

freshResearch.method: Separate English and Arabic web discovery followed by TLS-verified bounded anonymous GET requests to official ESA and Egyptian national GIS/ArcGIS routes. No credentials, login, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe-field request, coordinate shift, or TLS disablement was used.

portalsFound.observation: Official Egyptian Survey Authority. Its pages describe digital maps, cadastral-record/property mapping work and map products, but the inspected public pages provide service/procedure information rather than an anonymous parcel feature service for Samalut.
Official Egyptian national GIS ArcGIS FeatureServer. Exposed layers are Building, CITY, CENTER, STATE and Equipments; no parcel/cadastre layer was present in the service metadata.

requests.assessment: Official Survey Authority landing page retrieved. It describes mapping and cadastral-record activities but did not reveal a public parcel API route in the inspected HTML.
Service metadata retrieved. Layers were Building, CITY, CENTER, STATE and Equipments; no parcel layer or parcel schema was present.
Layer 0 metadata retrieved as a polygon Building layer. Fields include ID and building/property-related fields; this is not a cadastral parcel layer and no fields were retained in the packet.

Bounded anonymous query against the official Building layer returned an ArcGIS JSON error 400 (Unable to complete operation), not a parcel response. This is an access/service/query limitation and not evidence of citywide absence. The exact WUP point was not shifted.
Official digital-map service page describes requesting maps by location, scale, layers and projection, with delivery/pricing procedure; it does not expose an anonymous parcel feature endpoint.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Samalut, Minya Governorate, Egypt, with national ESA and Egyptian GIS routes.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: National cadastral/mapping agency and national GIS service context only; no Samalut parcel geometry, stable native parcel identity, parcel schema, or citywide open coverage verified.

remainingUncertainty: The public ESA workflow may require a service request or non-public data product. A current Samalut-specific cadastral viewer/API, parcel layer schema, CRS, stable native identity and coverage remain unresolved. The national GIS service inspected was not a parcel service. No exact-point hit or miss, map-extent miss, or citywide absence is inferred.
